issueDormant: The bot wakes automatically when an enabled feature is used. Your settings are preserved.
issueTimedOut: Normal bot work pauses until the timeout ends and access is verified.
retainedBan: The bot is still banned. Unbanning it will not automatically enable it.
issueConnectionCheckFailed: Access could not be confirmed. Retry when the problem is fixed.
issueBotBannedAutomatic: Unban the bot in Twitch. It will reconnect automatically. You can also retry to verify the unban.
issueBotBannedUnavailable: Automatic unban recovery is unavailable. Reconnect Twitch authorization, or unban the bot and retry to verify access.
